explanation: The e2e fixture starts each dashboard with no `firstContactPort`, so every dashboard in the run takes part in default-on first contact on the shared well-known port. Parallel workers' dashboards, registered under the same name, discover each other and appear in each other's sidebar depending on timing.
fix: Give the fixture an OS-assigned first-contact port (`freeLocalPort()`) so parallel workers' dashboards cannot discover each other.
